Hello, I am a main paladin holy player, I have been playing with this class for years since the classic and I also went through several expansions with this same class and specialization. I would like to express myself in a constructive way about the new paladin holy archetype that they just gave us, they want to make us heal in melee with this terrible rework design that they implemented to the class which as a veteran player I see it unfeasible and inefficient, next I will show some of my ideas about why this version of the paladin holy is unfeasible.

 1. As a melee healer I have to deal with the boses' silence mechanics which consequently decreases my efficiency as a healer.

 2. This brings me to the next point, as a melee healer I don't have enough hit to hit a raid boss and activate the mechanics of the new holy shovel system.

 3.The bonus set and armor of the paladin healer has never been benefited by the spirit stat since its main stat is Int, stamina and critical so the new set is completely unfeasible as this healer works.

Now I will mention some changes that really benefit the class:

 1. remove the [Blessed Strikes] talent since we are not going to heal to melee , if not as it has always been done efficiently at range.

 2. Bring back the [Divine Favor] talent that gives us 100% critical chance to heal which is very efficient in emergency cases to keep my tank or a raid member alive .
.
 3.Bring back the previous version of [Illumination] that for each critical heal the healing spells didn't charge you mana and therefore it was the only way to be able to keep mana during long fights.

Personally I think that the other talents are fine and don't need any changes... I think that with these changes they will bring back to life the pala holy that has been cruelly destroyed and put back together in a kind of a very bad frankenstein...(bring back the holy shock that does damage in the classic version).

Finally I would like to add something about the new holy paladin tier, this set should only give intellect and stamina, because the spirit they added is useless. My tier 3 is a thousand times more efficient than the new one. This only talking about stats, because, the design seems fantastic to me and I think it's the only thing that is useful to go to the new raid, as a healer paladin and get it for my transmog collection.
I hope they listen to our criticisms from the whole paladin community holy and can fix the class.
ps: as  you can see my native language is not the english i was trying to do the effort to communicate my thought about this  topic, i  hope  you guys  can understand it
pattern: 'I have been playing with this class for years since the classic... as a veteran player I see it unfeasible' -- veteran self-framing used to lend authority to a rework critique, closes with the same non-native-English apology pattern
context: Classes-Paladin: veteran critique of a class rework

And here is why this is in fact an ego problem and not everyone else sucking.

Playing alongside weaker players is a skill all in itself. If your tank struggles with more than two mobs, you sheep the third. If your group is slow you just match the pace.

Way to many people in all games fail to realize that playing in a way compatable with your teammates is a skill that has to be trained or honed. People who fail to do so arent good players by any metric

Wow is not a difficault game, but its a complex one. Depending on how hard you look you will find everyone making mistakes. But the players playing alongside you arent yout enemies and you will likely beat any dungeon with 4 monkeys tied together with duct tape.

That being said, if you use LFT for groupfinding, you engage the hardmode in terms of weak teammades. There is a reason anyone with options rather builds their groups with regular LFT. As you immediately filter out a large crowd of players unable to communicate in basic english
pattern: veteran framing: 'playing alongside weaker players is a skill all in itself' -- adapting to a bad tank/slow group is presented as the competent player's job, not the weak player's failing
